healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Outpatient mental health clinics with in-person and telehealth appointments

clinical_specialty.label: Clinical specialty
clinical_specialty.value: Outpatient mental health: psychiatry, therapy, psychology; mood, anxiety, ADHD, personality disorders, addiction, for adults and children

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix
payer_revenue_mix.value: Mostly commercial insurance, with Medicare Advantage plans and VA Community Care contracts; in-network with many plans

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Fee-for-service billing to in-network insurers for therapy and psychiatry visits

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: Over 550 outpatient mental health clinics across 35 states, plus telehealth in each state

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Routine outpatient behavioral health visits, with some intensive outpatient care, across all age groups

clinical_operating_quality.label: Clinical operating quality
clinical_operating_quality.value: Access measure: most patients scheduled within one week for therapy or psychiatry; no formal clinical outcome metric stated
